draft.text:
Draft - not sent. For approval by the Guildford procurement lead.

To: Comensura Limited
Subject: Contract IKEN 011240 - Managed Services for Temporary Agency Resources (Call-Off Contract under the ESPO MSTAR4 Framework Agreement 653F/23 dated 11 April 2023) - arrangements at vesting day

Dear supplier,

Our register shows that contract IKEN 011240 (Managed Services for Temporary Agency Resources (Call-Off Contract under the ESPO MSTAR4 Framework Agreement 653F/23 dated 11 April 2023)) with Guildford Borough Council ends on 2027-04-14, which is 13 days after the vesting day of the new West Surrey authority (2027-04-01). The register states a contract value of GBP 8,500,000.

Ahead of vesting day we need to agree one of: novation of this contract to the new authority, a short extension to align with the successor arrangements, or planned expiry. Please confirm your preferred route and any conditions by return.

This letter is a draft prepared from the published contracts register (entry gui:guildford_contracts_2026_q4.xlsx:99) and requires human approval before it is sent.
